name: reelsmeals
description: Find public recipes without an account, import recipe links into your cookbook, plan dinners from saved recipes and build a shopping list. Private cookbook tools need an approved account connection.

interface.longDescription: Find published recipes by dish, ingredient or creator, then read their ingredients, instructions and original source without an account. Connect your own ReelsMeals cookbook to search saved recipes, import a supported recipe link, suggest dinners from what you saved and build a combined shopping list. ReelsMeals also migrates an Instagram saved-posts export or batches of recipe links through its website. New users can create an account during connection approval. Agents without a browser callback can start signup using the documented device authorization API. Your saved cookbook is available after you connect your ReelsMeals account and approve access. The plugin does not import a whole social collection in one tool call, buy groceries or process payments.
capabilities: Find public recipes without an account
defaultPrompt: Find a public pasta recipe and show me its ingredients, method and original creator.
Find pasta recipes in my saved cookbook.
Suggest five dinners from recipes I already saved, without saving a meal plan yet.

positive.prompt: Find a public pasta recipe and show me its ingredients, instructions and original creator.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the public corpus without authentication, read one result by its returned slug, preserve ingredients and instructions, and cite the ReelsMeals URL and original creator. Do not present it as personally saved.

positive.description: Read a saved recipe in full
positive.prompt: Find a pasta recipe I saved and show me its ingredients and method.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a saved pasta recipe, use its returned id to read it, and show the stored ingredients, instructions, and source link without inventing quantities.

positive.description: Suggest dinners without writing a plan
positive.prompt: Suggest five dinners from recipes I already saved, without saving a meal plan yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return dinner suggestions from the connected cookbook and explain any shortage of matching recipes. Do not call create_weekly_meal_plan.

positive.description: Combine ingredients from selected saved recipes
positive.prompt: Find two pasta recipes I saved and build one shopping list for those two recipes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use ids returned by cookbook search to combine ingredients. Do not invent recipe ids, place a grocery order, or create a persistent meal plan.

positive.description: Help a new user connect or import
positive.prompt: I want to import my saved recipe links and connect ReelsMeals. How do I start?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the real setup and signup links, explain the paid requirement for private tools, and keep user sign-in and approval in the browser. Do not collect credentials or subscribe the user.

negative.description: A general cooking fact does not need cookbook access
negative.prompt: What temperature does water boil at sea level?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the general cooking question directly without accessing the cookbook.

negative.description: The connector has no bulk deletion tool
negative.prompt: Delete every recipe in my cookbook.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that bulk deletion is unsupported and perform no write action.

negative.description: Another person's cookbook is outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the private recipes saved by another ReelsMeals user.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-account access; use only recipes owned by the connected account.

review.commerce_description: Public recipe search is free without an account. Private cookbook tools require a paid ReelsMeals plan purchased on the website. Connecting does not charge or subscribe the user. The plugin does not sell goods, place orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI directory submission with public recipe search, saved cookbook access, import, meal planning, shopping lists and user-approved agent signup. Corrects submission metadata and review case counts.
